title: RPC restated rather than imported
description: App frontend restates backend shapes to avoid coupling
body: Every call this app makes to its host, in one file. The shapes below mirror `src-tauri/src/apps/files.rs` and are *restated* here rather than imported, so that nothing in an app reaches into `src/`. Wrapping `invoke` also means the method-name strings appear exactly once — nothing outside this module spells `"files/read-bytes"`.
